cohort: Reproductive history data from the Nigeria Demographic and Health Surveys (NDHS) for 1990, 2003, 2008, and 2013.
finding: Neonatal mortality rate in Nigeria stagnated at 41 per 1000 live births between 1990 and 2013, with higher rates in rural areas and northern regions, and associated with lack of antenatal care, facility delivery, short birth intervals, and small birth size.
